game_title: Nested While Dungeon – Exit Light Ledge Streak
game_concept: A card battler set in Shadow Cave – Exit Light Ledge, a ledge toward daylight: the spelunker must handle cave spiders while practicing control flow: while loops. Core idea – Nested While Dungeon: Run an inner loop for each room inside an outer loop for each floor.
theme: Shadow Cave – Exit Light Ledge: a ledge toward daylight
core_gameplay_loop: In Exit Light Ledge, repeat each round: Run an inner loop for each room inside an outer loop for each floor. Each round poses one decision; a wrong answer breaks the streak. Then check the dungeon_clear value and advance.
player_objective: Chain 9 consecutive correct decisions about dungeon_clear to power up the spelunker and open the stone seal.
controls: Keyboard: arrow keys move the hero, SPACE performs the main action, ENTER runs the code.
lose_condition: lives reach 0 (each wrong decision costs a life and resets the streak).
learning_alignment: Week 4 – Control Flow: While Loops | Level 1 (intro tier): Nested While Dungeon
assets_style: dark pixel-art cavern: torchlit stone, mossy rock, deep shadows, glowing crystals; flat Kenney-style sprites; echoing drips, low drones and torch crackle

Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against cave spiders in Exit Light Ledge.
